title: COVID-19 Epidemiological Update — Special Edition (24 December 2024)
multimodal_evidence: Global and WHO-region COVID-19 case and death epidemic curves, SARS-CoV-2 variant-proportion charts, and regional surveillance data tables (52 pp.).

title: Noncommunicable Diseases Progress Monitor 2025
multimodal_evidence: Country NCD profiles (238 pp.) with premature-mortality figures for cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes and chronic respiratory disease and 11-indicator progress tables. Chronic-disease theme.

title: TAMIFLU (oseltamivir phosphate) Capsules and Oral Suspension — Full Prescribing Information
multimodal_evidence: Dosage and Administration (Section 2) with weight-based and renal-impairment dose-adjustment tables (PDF p.2 onward); adverse-reaction incidence tables (Section 6); pharmacokinetic tables (Section 12). Influenza antiviral (neuraminidase inhibitor), pairs with Xofluza.

title: XOFLUZA (baloxavir marboxil) Tablets and Granules — Full Prescribing Information
multimodal_evidence: Weight-based single-dose dosing table, adverse-reaction incidence tables, and pharmacokinetic tables. Influenza antiviral (PA endonuclease inhibitor), same indication class as Tamiflu.

title: PAXLOVID (nirmatrelvir tablets; ritonavir tablets) — Full Prescribing Information
multimodal_evidence: Renal-impairment dosing tables, extensive drug-drug interaction tables, and adverse-reaction incidence tables (46 pp.). COVID-19 antiviral.

title: OZEMPIC (semaglutide) Injection, for Subcutaneous Use — Full Prescribing Information
multimodal_evidence: Adverse-reaction / hypoglycemia incidence tables (e.g., add-on-to-basal-insulin hypoglycemia table on PDF p.9); dose-escalation schedule (Section 2); HbA1c efficacy tables (Section 14 Clinical Studies). GLP-1 receptor agonist, chronic-disease/drug theme.

title: MOUNJARO (tirzepatide) Injection, for Subcutaneous Use — Full Prescribing Information
multimodal_evidence: Dose-escalation table, adverse-reaction incidence tables, and HbA1c/body-weight efficacy tables (37 pp.). GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist, same class as Ozempic.
